input.development_label_role: evaluation only, never passed to fit/feature/scaler construction
input.Q_units: project numeric Q units; m3/s primary provenance UNVERIFIED
input.sampling: daily date index; daily mean and physical day boundary UNVERIFIED

S1A-0.calendar: 12 target-train monthly means on common training support

S1A-1.calendar: exact same frozen within-fold S1A-0 climate
S1A-1.upstream_scale: per-feature train std after monthly centering, ddof=0
S1A-1.model: 3-coefficient OLS on target residuals with no additional intercept

common_support.primary_score_dates: predeclared full development calendar, shared feature support; missing support => stop, no posthoc intersection selection

decision_rules.consistent_development_gain: positive RMSE gain in all 3 dev years, macro relative gain >=2%, conditional paired-bootstrap lower bound >0 at both prespecified block lengths
decision_rules.mixed_or_uncertain: otherwise; failure to find stable gain does not prove no upstream information
decision_rules.robust_usefulness_guard: any year absolute PBIAS worsens by >2 percentage points or low-flow RMSE worsens >5% => mark tradeoff/NOT_ROBUST even if aggregate improves
decision_rules.peak_timing: signed and absolute annual-max-date error, ties earliest; diagnostic, no method selection
decision_rules.residual_error: remove the same target-training climate from obs and prediction; algebraically same error, not a second independent endpoint

uncertainty.bootstrap: paired circular moving block within development year; equal year weights; conditional on fitted model

placebo.source_centering: fit W(s) monthly moments on original full legal train anchors; center at month(s), scale; then move anchor s=t-k
placebo.source_parameter_fit_anchors: original full fold.train; no dev source moments
placebo.target_climate: same original full train target monthly climate for every k including 0
placebo.beta_fit_sources: all s=t-k in original full training anchor calendar
placebo.score_dates: dev[:-90], all k including 0; source anchors <= dev_end; no wrapping
placebo.missing_values: stop; do not let Q-dependent exclusion change support
summaries: all 13 displacement gains and metrics per year
mean near gain minus mean far gain
mean far gain and far/g(0) if g(0)>0
placebo.interpretation: descriptive synchronization sensitivity; no transport/causal identification
placebo.mask_scope_warning: 275 calendar days Jan1-Oct2 per dev year, not full-year placebo evidence

S1A-SENS1.upstream_transform: same frozen monthly upstream anomaly transform as primary
S1A-SENS1.contrast: F2+three upstream coefficients versus F2 only; same dates/clipping

S1A-SENS2.required_input: separate observer-assisted view of DSK history through t-1; dev own-past explicitly allowed ONLY in this view
S1A-SENS2.comparison: descriptive full-dev scores against fixed monthly and upstream models, not missing-station ranking

difference_cross_correlation.lags: not implemented or searched; cannot infer day boundary

HAC_DM_CW.reason: requires separately specified loss process, nesting and dependence assumptions

reference_R1.regime2_role: NOT_COMPARABLE_INPUT_REGIME; do not shift predictions or reroute

same_day_secondary: original S0.1 definition retained; not implemented/run/ranked in R0

evidence_levels.L2: descriptive synchronization-sensitive prediction; conditional on placebo pattern

unresolved: common meteorological forcing and interannual states uncontrolled
future_execution_stops: no user authorization for executing S1A
input hashes or station mapping mismatch
unsupported or duplicate/missing dates; negative/nonfinite Q; missing feature windows beyond prescribed warmup
monthly train climate undefined; feature std <=1e-12; rank !=3
access to development/unknown candidate target labels from fit/scaler/feature process
attempt to tune lag/window/harmonics or refit R1/R2/Fourier6/D5
attempt to promote exposed development results to independent final or strict zero-shot
R0 phase prohibits all real fitting/prediction/scoring
any k-specific train/score support or source transform drift
future placebo mixed into lawful main model ranking
manual lag/harmonic/CI selection or elevation to independent confirmation
